name: MDS1 and EVI1 complex locus

function.text: MECOM encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase MECOM. Annotated molecular activities include histone H3 methyltransferase activity and histone H3K9 methyltransferase activity. It participates in heterochromatin organization and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to MECOM-associated syndrome (autosomal dominant); radioulnar synostosis with amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Acute myeloid leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
